name: Coral des Abimes
description: Architecte des Abysses créant des écosystèmes aquatiques autonomes capables de survivre dans le vide spatial le plus hostile.

subject.archetype: Coral des Abimes — Exode pélagique Legendary class eau

loadout.armor_outfit: Organic coral armor grown from living reef material with bioluminescent combat indicators pulsing in rapid rhythm, hydrodynamic fins extending from arms and calves streaming in current, translucent membranes trailing from shoulders with legendary cosmic materials and ancient craftsmanship that has become one with the wearer's being
loadout.arsenal: Bioluminescent harpoon cannon with living coral barrel pulsing with each discharge, hydro-kinetic gauntlets channeling water into pressurized cutting jets visible as focused force streams The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's decrease ability targeting opposite_side, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Both hands thrust forward in powerful push with massive devastating dimensional pressure field expanding from palms creating visible wall of force pushing against entire opposing side
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — no longer merely fighting but reshaping the battlefield itself with every movement and breath

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Abyssal Deep Blue
palette_names.role: primary_accent — skin tones and surrounding water mass

palette_names.name: Bioluminescent Cyan
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — ability effects and natural body glow

palette_names.name: Foam White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — spray splashes and bubble highlights

color_and_light.lighting_setup: aurum-plated frame with living energy flowing through ornate faction-specific patterns, border radiates golden glow, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Cinematic ultra-wide angle with dramatic depth layers — foreground devastation, character as glowing focal point, background cataclysm, sky and environment permanently altered

scenography.setting: Storm-ravaged aquatic colonial battlefield with massive waves crashing over organic structures sending debris flying, lightning illuminating in stark flashes, allied forces pushed back while bioluminescent defensive flares light the water column with cyan bursts
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Massive force visible through environmental disruption — air rippling like heat haze, ground buckling and cracking, everything on opposite side being physically pushed backward and compressed, Opposing terrain visibly compressed and pushed backward, barriers and structures cracking from extreme pressure, objects sliding away creating clear zone of force, Massive waves crashing and spraying bioluminescent droplets everywhere, water vortex spiraling around character pulling debris, glowing fish scattering in panic, bubbles erupting from seabed, electrical arcs flashing through charged seawater
